question: Should this LRU-style draft PR or the sibling FIFO-cap PR be the canonical fix for the linked model-pricing cache issue?
rationale: Both PRs target the same open issue with different eviction semantics, and a maintainer should choose the intended policy before either candidate lands.

options.title: Continue this PR after proof
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical path because it bounds all state replacements while preserving recently used rows, after the contributor adds real runtime proof and exits draft.

options.title: Prefer the sibling cap PR
options.body: Use the sibling PR if maintainers prefer the smaller FIFO-style cap and accept that it does not preserve cache-hit recency.

options.title: Ask contributors to consolidate
options.body: Have the authors converge on one branch so review and CI do not split across two competing fixes for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Continue this PR after proof
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical path because it bounds all state replacements while preserving recently used rows, after the contributor adds real runtime proof and exits draft.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cache implementation entered main through a PR authored and merged by `steipete`, making them the best available owner for the cache policy choice.
